## Localization and preservation

<!-- Mark only applicable items; explain exceptions. -->

- [ ] Core behavioral prompt bodies and source policies remain unchanged; any output-language change is identified separately.
- [ ] Application-owned display text is English, with source catalogs retained.
- [ ] Catalog keys, arguments, ICU branches, and rich-text tags match across `en.json`, `ko.json`, and `zh.json`.
- [ ] Commands, payloads, URLs, identifiers, raw evidence, and audit records retain their original content.
- [ ] Shared model/display messages and language-sensitive parsing consumers were reviewed and tested where changed.
- [ ] Existing user-written content, custom prompts/settings, and permission, approval, and scope controls remain intact.

## Scope and repository handling

- [ ] Validation used synthetic data or an explicitly authorized environment; no unapproved remote testing or paid model calls were performed.
- [ ] No secrets, real target evidence, or private HumanWill research were added to fixtures, screenshots, logs, or repository files.
- [ ] License notices, attribution, and source history are preserved.
- [ ] This change does not publish releases/images, enable release workflows, or change repository visibility.
